P2P baby monitor web app using WebRTC (PeerJS) with Vite + TypeScript. Two modes: Baby Station (streams camera/mic) and Parent Station (receives stream).

src/: main.ts entry/routing/URL state; baby-station.ts camera/mic streaming, QR code, settings drawer; parent-station.ts receives stream, audio/motion meters, alerts; motion-detection.ts frame differencing; utils.ts wake lock, media helpers, audio meter; style.css global styles, CSS custom properties, dark theme; dictionary.ts random room ID word generator; *.test.ts colocated Vitest tests. tests/ Playwright e2e tests (excluded from Vitest). scripts/ dev cert generation. certs/ self-signed TLS certs (dev only, gitignored keys). public/ static assets.

**Module structure**: Each station is self-contained with `init*` function returning `CleanupHandle`  
**Cleanup pattern**: All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for prop
